title: Dream/mallworld meetup verification process, this should be pretty interesting.

classification.theory_summary: Proposes a community method to verify alleged dream meetups using private key numbers/phrases exchanged in-dream and verified via messages after waking; mentions possibility of collective unconscious vs individual mind.
classification.question_topic: How to create a verification process for meeting specific subreddit users in dreams; how to 'tune in' to specific people.
classification.skip_reason: No actual dream narrative, locations, events, or perceptual details described—proposal/discussion only.

meta.author_theory: Suggests testing whether dream meetups indicate a collective unconscious vs an individual's mind; proposes verification via exchanging unique private keys in dreams and confirming after waking.

extraction.extraction_notes: Post contains a proposed verification protocol for dream meetups (private key exchange) but does not describe any specific dream episode, setting, entities, or sensory/environmental qualities.
